specialRules.ruleFull: When spotting a hidden enemy, a member of the warband adds +2 to the distance at which he can spot him.
The warband pays double upkeep for any Hired Sword who is not an Elf. It may hire only Elven or human Hired Swords, never a Dark Elf and never a witch.
A member of the warband may wear no heavy armour other than Ithilmar armour. He may still use a magical armour he comes by.
A member of the warband may never use a poison or a drug, and the warband may hire no Hired Sword who uses one.
A member of the warband may drink no alcohol other than Elf Wine.
The warband may capture Swabbies. One who agrees joins the Ship's Company; one who refuses joins the Raw Recruits.
The warband starts with no blackpowder weapon of any kind and no list sells one, but nothing forbids one: a Hero with the Weapons Expert skill may use any powder weapon he finds.
Any warrior within 6" of the Commodore may use his Leadership for any Leadership test.
A Mist Mage is a wizard and casts from the Spells of the Lothern Sea list.
A Mist Mage may not wear armour while casting spells.
Any warrior within 3" of a Bossun may use his Leadership instead of his own.
In the first round of combat with a spear, a Seaguard adds +1 Strength and may re-roll one failed roll to hit.
An opponent trying to spot a Sea Ranger halves his Initiative.
A Sea Ranger hates Dark Elves.
Raw Recruits may be hired as normal, and may also be taken the way Swabbies are.
A Raw Recruit never gains experience.

Raw Recruits need not be armed alike. Each may be given different equipment, but only from the Recruit Equipment list. A Raw Recruit may never use magic or cast a spell of any kind, whatever his background.
If the warband routs, every Raw Recruit who had already left the table in an earlier turn is taken to have escaped: remove him from the roster as if he had been killed.

specialRules.rulename: Don't mind them, they aren't true elves
specialRules.ruleFull: A Raw Recruit who is running away or has been taken out of action does not count towards the warband's rout test.

skillGroup.name: Lothern Sea Patrol
skillGroup.note: Infiltration: a Hero with the Ranger honour and a promoted Sea Ranger only.

specialSkillsList.name: Graceful Strength
specialSkillsList.description: The Elf may use a double-handed weapon without striking last; work out the order of blows as for any other weapon.

specialSkillsList.name: Swordmasters Protege
specialSkillsList.description: Swordmasters only. When armed with a double-handed weapon he may parry as if armed with a sword and a buckler.

specialSkillsList.name: Defending Guard
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior may parry a blow made against any warrior within 1" of him, but still only once a turn. He may not use this while stunned or knocked down.

specialSkillsList.name: Swift Fighter
specialSkillsList.description: At the end of any hand-to-hand combat phase, either player's, the Elf may take a Leadership test if he is still in base contact with an enemy. If he passes he may make a normal move away from the enemy, who strikes no blows at him; he may not run or charge. If he fails he stays in combat and fights as normal the following turn. If he also knows the Pirate skill Swashbuckler, he may make one attempt to escape combat and re-roll it once if it fails.

flags.what: The skill table's ticks are images, so page 2 was opened as an image. Commodore: Combat, Shooting, Academic, Speed, Pirate, Special. Mist Mage: Academic, Speed, Special. Bossun: Combat, Shooting, Speed, Pirate, Special. None of the three ticks Strength.

The Pirate column is the Pirate Skills list of the Sartosa campaign rules (Sartosa Skills, Hired Swords and Dramatis Personae, p1-2), not this PDF: it is the shared Sartosa Pirate Skills group, declared in sartosan-pirates.json and named by each hero who ticks it.

The Warrior Equipment List is set in two columns and the right column repeats Long Bow 15 gc and the armour block (Shield 5, Helmet 10, Light armour 20) with no heading of its own, adding Elf Bow 35 gc and Throwing Knives 15 gc. It is read as one list: the left column plus those two.

The Ranger Equipment List prints hand-to-hand weapons and a Bow and no armour at all; the armour block in the right column follows the Recruit list's missile block and is read as the Recruit list's. As printed, a Sea Ranger buys no armour from his list.

The Warrior and Ranger lists sell an Ithilmar Weapon at "2 x Cost", a multiplier and not a number, so its line carries no price of its own and reads "2 x Cost", as the Dwarf Treasure Hunters' Gromril line does. Ours is Rare 9 at three times the price, which is unchanged.

The Ithilmar Armour line is 60 gc (the footnote says Ithilmar is cheaper for them at creation); ours is 90 gc, Rare 11, which is unchanged. The Elf Bow line is 35 gc; ours is 35 + 3D6 gc, Rare 12, which is unchanged.
Raw Recruits are taken by Special Recruitment and "may be hired like normal", but no hire price is printed, so their cost is 0 gc.

The Honours are bought once, at recruitment, and change a Hero's rules, skills, list and stats. William, 11 Nov 2026: a fighter's buyable extra rules are template upgrades, never a warband rule, so they are the upgrade group Honours, with every cost as printed; its terms (heroes only, one each, bought at recruitment) are in template_answers.UPGRADE_TERMS. The Loremaster's 15 gc for a Bossun is in its text, as an upgrade carries one price.

Fey Quickness is our skill of that name and effect (a 6, or a 4+ with Dodge or Step Aside), so it is linked rather than written again. Swordmasters Protege and Infiltration each name who may take them. Swordmasters Protege is a new skill, so its limit opens its description; Infiltration is our skill, so its limit sits in the group's note.

The Spells of the Lothern Sea are the Spells of the Djedhi we already hold, with the fourth, Fleeting Shadows, replaced by Mistress of the Deep (difficulty 8). The lore is added as its own, taking our wording for the five that are the same.

The warband must hold between 3 and 12 models: our templates hold no minimum, so only the maximum of 12 is imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profile are printed: the warband takes our Elf race, the Raw Recruits included, though their entry says some are not full elves.
The Commodore's profile is M5 WS5 BS4 S3 T3 W1 I5 A1 Ld9 and the Bossun's M5 WS4 BS4 S3 T3 W1 I5 A1 Ld8: as printed.

mutations.mutationflavour: A Hero may buy one honour, and only one, when he is recruited; he may never gain another later. An honour is often part of the model's name.

items.heading: Pure of Heart
items.ruleFull: The Hero passes the first Leadership test he must take each game, rout tests excepted if he is the leader, but he may not charge a stunned foe.

items.heading: Spearmaster
items.ruleFull: In the first round of combat with a spear, the Hero adds +1 Strength and may re-roll one failed roll to hit.

items.heading: Swordmaster
items.ruleFull: The Hero gains +1 Weapon Skill and starts with the Graceful Strength skill. He may never use a missile weapon and may never raise his Ballistic Skill.

items.heading: Sea Guard
items.ruleFull: Besides the Warrior Equipment list, the Hero may buy and use an Elf Bow without further training. Armed with a spear he fights at +2 Initiative when working out the order of blows.

items.heading: White Lion
items.ruleFull: The Hero starts with Strength 4 and a white lion pelt, a cloak giving +1 to his armour save against missile attacks, which only a White Lion may wear and costs 10 gold crowns to replace with no rarity roll. He may never use a spear and loses access to Shooting skills, though he may use missile weapons as normal.

items.heading: Phoenix Guard
items.ruleFull: Only one Hero in the warband may take this honour. He may not speak, so he may not be the warband's leader and may not look for rare items. He is immune to psychology and rolls two dice for exploration. An immune leader still rolls for rout.

items.heading: Ranger
items.ruleFull: Only one Hero in the warband may take this honour. He must carry a long bow or an Elf Bow at all times, and one must be bought for him as soon as the warband can. He buys from the Ranger Equipment list instead of the Warrior Equipment list, and gains Seeker, which lets him change one dice roll in the exploration phase by +1 or -1.

items.heading: Loremaster
items.ruleFull: The Hero starts with an Academic skill of your choice. A Bossun may take this honour too and may then also learn Academic skills, but it costs him 15 gold crowns instead of 10.
